name: Runpod
description: Runs AI workloads on Runpod GPUs with autoscaling serverless endpoints, on-demand Pods, and network volumes, managed via REST API, the runpod Python SDK and rp CLI, or a hosted MCP.

skills.name: Serverless Endpoints
skills.description: Deploys worker images from Docker Hub or GitHub as pay-as-you-go endpoints with queue-based or load-balanced scaling.

skills.name: Pods
skills.description: Creates, starts, stops, and terminates on-demand GPU Pods from the console, the REST API, or the rp CLI.

skills.name: Runpod SDK Apps
skills.description: Runs local Python functions on Runpod GPUs and deploys them as endpoints with rp flash dev and rp flash deploy.

skills.name: Network Volumes
skills.description: Attaches persistent network volumes to Pods and endpoints and manages their files through an S3-compatible API.

skills.name: Public Endpoints
skills.description: Calls pre-deployed image, video, audio, and text models with an API key and no deployment of your own.
